'''Koyi Komad''' was a student in the [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy|Trade and Science Academy]] where she studied [[hyperspatial physics]] under [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Rorax Falken]], with xenopsych as an elective. There she became friends with [[Anki Pace]].

During the [[Phantom Project|Phantom Affair]], while [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] were on their leave, they met Koyi in a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], [[The Soundmound]], where she worked as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]]. Becoming fast friends, Koyi helped the Rogues escape imprisonment by hiding them in a safe place in the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] above the Academy campus. This adventure helped open her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] to 'the bigger hologram' and she opted for work-study, eventually joining Rogue Squadron.

At the time of the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], Koyi was the Squadron's chief [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]]. Her skills with a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]] earned her high praise from the always-critical [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo|Plourr]].

She later [[Wedding of Nrin Vakil and Koyi Komad|married]] Rogue [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nrin Vakil]] and invited Anki to her [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]].

==Personality and traits==
Komad had [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin, pink colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="RS6" /> She had two pairs of three vertical black lines on each side of her knobby brow,<ref name="RS6" /> and frequently draped her [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] head-[[Limb/Legends|tails]] over her shoulders.<ref name="RS6" /><ref name="RS22">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 22|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 22]]</ref><ref name="RS35">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref> Her name originated in Twi'lek culture, where the feminine first name "Koyi" meant "[[Snake/Legends|serpent]]," and her clan surname "Komad" translated to "chivalry" or "chivalrous."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Koyi Komad first appeared in the [[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 6|sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="RS6" /> on [[March 12]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54651/star_wars_x-wing_rogue_squadron_1995_6|text=Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron (1995) #6}}</ref> The issue was written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] and [[Darko Macan]], and illustrated by [[Edvin Biuković]].<ref name="RS6" />

[[Koyi Mateil/Legends|Koyi Mateil]], a character from the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="DaG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]],<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> is incorrectly identified as Komad in the costume gallery of ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', a reference book written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and published on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
